high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the verified account "alessandro_michele." The post features two models walking down a runway during a fashion show. Both models are wearing matching orange jackets with the word "FUORI!!!" prominently displayed on them. The jackets have a textured, almost splattered appearance, and the cuffs feature a black-and-white checkered pattern. The models are also wearing gray trousers, white shirts underneath their jackets, and black ties.
